text:
Mike (Partnerships): quick sync — we're lining up the marketplace + partner SI/hardware listing for the week of May 12. main asks: press embargo, partner quotes, logos, integration guide, and demo video. who can own each?
Nancy (Marketing): I can run press and blog cadence. need partner-approved quotes and logos by Mon EOD or we push PR. can someone confirm embargo window? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Tina (Legal): embargo ok but we need trademark/logo usage checklist returned with each asset. I'll send the template now. logos must be SVG + PNG 2x. also need partner consent for quotes (one-line stmt ok).
Jeff (Design): design side — I'll produce hero + partner grid mockups. request: logos in original colors and a short blurb (max 80 chars) for the partner card. also will need a 16:9 thumbnail for the demo video.
Ollie (Eng): integration docs — I'll ship a v0.1 "Marketplace Quickstart for SI" (md) by Tue morning. need sample API keys and a small demo payload from partners to test the listing flow. also confirm whether the hardware partner needs SKU mapping for the listing.
Mike (Partnerships): embargo proposal: Fri May 16 10:00 PT release. internal dry run Thu 9am PT. can we hit assets+quotes by Mon? if not we move to next week.
Nancy (Marketing): confirmed for PR timeline if assets by Mon. I'll stub blog draft and social copy today, will leave placeholders for partner quotes. tracking: use utm_campaign=partner-marketplace-may and unique utm_content per partner.
Sara (PM): adding rollout constraints — Dedicated capacity customers should be excluded from the public listing until our Dedicated contract approval flows finish. Ollie, can listing be flagged private for specific tenant IDs?
Ollie (Eng): yes — marketplace listing metadata supports "private_preview" flag per tenant. will add an access control toggle and document it in the quickstart.
Tina (Legal): side note: partner NDA/embargo clauses — please don't post any partner quotes publicly until contracts signed. I'll compile list of pending legal approvals and tag owners.
Jeff (Design): putting the hero comp in Figma now -> will share link. small ask: product screenshot needs to show the SI integration page; Ollie can you export a clean mock endpoint for that?
Ollie (Eng): will export a sanitized example response and a short script to generate sample data.
Mike (Partnerships): hardware partner (EdgeGrid) wants a "Powered by" badge. Tina — any special brand rules?
Tina (Legal): require brand usage form signed + exact badge placement rules. I'll attach the checklist to the thread.
Nancy (Marketing): press contacts: assign @pressbot to schedule embargo email to the list once we have legal signoff. also recommend a co-authored blog with partner head of product — keeps quotes tight.
pressbot: scheduled_reminder: "Embargo email draft due Mon 14:00 PT" -> will ping Nancy and Mike if not updated.
Mike (Partnerships): ok owners recap:
- Press & blog: Nancy
- Partner quotes & logos: Partners -> Mike to collect
- Legal approvals + logo usage: Tina
- Design assets (hero, grid, thumbnail): Jeff
- Integration quickstart & sample payloads: Ollie
- Demo video coordination: Mike + Nancy
- Release gating (private preview flag): Ollie

I'll update the shared spreadsheet with owners and deadlines.
Sara (PM): timeline check — if assets in by Mon EOD and legal signoff Tue noon, we can keep Fri release. if any item slips, move to next-week Friday to give partners breathing room. please confirm by EOD. :white_check_mark:
Nancy (Marketing): confirming I'll push for Mon but will flag issues early.
Jeff (Design): will upload Figma link and exportables by Tue AM.
Tina (Legal): will circulate logo/trade template now, aiming for Tue noon signoffs on partners that already signed standard MSA.
Ollie (Eng): quickstart v0.1 PR incoming Tue 08:30 PT. will include sample curl and the private_preview flag example.
Mike (Partnerships): thanks. if anyone needs a one-pager for partners to speed signoff, I can draft it tonight. otherwise we'll reconvene Thu 09:00 for dry run.
Sara (PM): great — reconvene Thu 09:00 for dry run. please react with :thumbsup: when you own your task.
